item.title: Gambino crime family boss Paul Castellano murdered outside Manhattan steakhouse 40 years ago - The Mob Museum
item.description: Forty years ago, a faction of Gambino crime family members orchestrated and executed a brazen coup to permanently remove their contentious boss, Paul Castellano. On December 16, 1985, assailants shot and killed him in the heart of holiday shopping season in Midtown Manhattan.
